name: Unlock Gardening With Blanc
summary: Open the starter plot route, learn seed buying, and keep every box active.
steps: Meet Blanc through the gardening tutorial
Place or use starter plant boxes
Buy Tomato and Potato seeds before experimenting
Water and harvest once before leaving the route

name: Seed Shop And Blanc Route
summary: Use shop and map handoffs so seed buying is a planned stop, not a memory check.
steps: Open Shops and search seeds
Check Blanc or Garden Shop source notes
Buy only enough seed for the selected play window
Save Gold for tool upgrades before overbuying late seeds

name: Active Short-Session Loop
summary: Use Tomato and Pineapple when you are staying online and can harvest repeatedly.
steps: Plant Tomato for 15-minute starter loops
Switch to Pineapple after the unlock if you want a 30-minute route
Use the Profit Calculator before filling all boxes
Replant immediately after each harvest

name: One To Two Hour Crop Route
summary: Use Potato and Carrot when you can harvest once or twice in the same session.
steps: Use Potato as the early one-hour baseline
Use Carrot for a two-hour route after Lv 5
Check Fish and Chips before selling all Potato raw
Use Crop Planner when box count changes

name: Before Logout Route
summary: Use Wheat, Lettuce, Corn, or long crops when growth should happen while away.
steps: Plant Wheat or Lettuce before logging off
Use Corn when the 12-hour route fits your next login
Set a timer if you want to return near harvest
Use Animal Favorites before spending Corn or Wheat on food tests

name: Profit And Recipe Decision
summary: Compare raw sale, recipe use, and animal-food overlap before mass planting.
steps: Open Profit Calculator for the selected crop
Check Recipes for crop sinks like jam or Fish and Chips
Check Animal Favorites for Corn, Wheat, or food overlap
Add uncertain crops to the crop watchlist
